scope: Source-scoped portfolio metrics; no cross-domain totals or audited finance claims

metrics.name: Completed item value
metrics.definition: SUM(revenue), with revenue populated only for current complete items
metrics.null_policy: Missing source amount is invalid input; returned items contribute zero
metrics.limits: Current status, not recognized book revenue, cash receipts or net sales

metrics.name: Period-distinct completed orders
metrics.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) where at least one selected item is complete
metrics.null_policy: Zero only when an observed period contains no eligible orders
metrics.limits: Mixed completed/returned orders remain eligible; daily order-day totals are not period-distinct orders

metrics.name: Completed order incidences by attributed channel
metrics.definition: Distinct completed order IDs separately within each channel/source group
metrics.null_policy: Zero only within an observed source scope with no eligible orders
metrics.limits: A multi-item order can appear in several attributed channels; channel counts must not be summed as period-distinct orders

metrics.name: Completed item value per completed order
metrics.definition: Completed item value divided by period-distinct completed orders
metrics.denominator: Orders with at least one completed item in the same selected period
metrics.null_policy: Null when denominator is zero
metrics.limits: Do not use summed daily distinct orders or average item price as this denominator

metrics.name: Returned item share
metrics.definition: 100 * returned item count / (completed item count + returned item count)
metrics.denominator: Only current complete or returned item rows
metrics.null_policy: Null without eligible item rows
metrics.limits: Not order return probability, cash refunded, product defect rate or a causal product-quality conclusion

metrics.name: Returned item value
metrics.definition: SUM(returned_revenue) for current returned rows
metrics.null_policy: Zero when no observed rows are returned
metrics.limits: Never subtract again from completed item value; refund settlement is unavailable

metrics.name: Known-cost completed product contribution
metrics.definition: SUM(revenue - cost) on completed items with a non-null nonnegative unit cost
metrics.null_policy: Null if no completed item has an eligible cost
metrics.limits: Excludes unpriced rows, shipping, logistics and advertising; not net profit; observed catalog cost is not verified transaction-time COGS

metrics.name: Known-cost product margin rate
metrics.definition: 100 * known-cost product contribution / known-cost completed item value
metrics.denominator: Completed revenue from exactly the same known-cost item rows
metrics.null_policy: Null when matched revenue is zero
metrics.limits: Incomplete-cost rows cannot enter the denominator; display coverage alongside the rate

metrics.name: Completed-value cost coverage
metrics.definition: 100 * completed item value with eligible unit cost / all completed item value
metrics.denominator: All completed item value in the same selection
metrics.null_policy: Null without completed item value
metrics.limits: Coverage is not an estimate of missing costs or an uncertainty interval

metrics.name: Historical sessions
metrics.definition: COUNT(*) from the tested session-grain mart
metrics.null_policy: Absence of a source is not zero traffic
metrics.limits: A session_id alone can belong to different users; separate from GA4 sessions

metrics.name: Event session conversion
metrics.definition: 100 * converted session rows / all eligible session rows
metrics.denominator: All observed session/user pairs in the same source and period
metrics.null_policy: Null without sessions
metrics.limits: Purchase events do not establish completed order settlement or causal marketing uplift

metrics.name: Raw-branch sales value
metrics.definition: SUM(revenue) from raw-branch sales, reconciled to finance day
metrics.null_policy: Missing source amounts must remain a coverage issue
metrics.limits: Not combined with E-Commerce; no verified currency conversion or refund ledger adjustment

metrics.name: Model product contribution
metrics.definition: SUM(revenue - quantity * purchase_price); NULL line margins are excluded by SUM
metrics.null_policy: Missing line costs do not become verified zero costs
metrics.limits: Sales revenue includes unpriced lines even when their margin is omitted; coverage must be disclosed; observed product purchase prices are not verified historical COGS

metrics.name: Model operational contribution
metrics.definition: Model product margin + shipping fee - logistics cost - shipping cost, using the existing zero policies for missing components
metrics.null_policy: Model-imputed zeros are flagged separately from complete source components
metrics.limits: Not audited operating profit; missing product/shipping components affect interpretation

metrics.name: Model contribution after advertising
metrics.definition: Operational contribution minus advertising spend on the same date
metrics.null_policy: Full outer join preserves spend without orders
metrics.limits: Descriptive accounting identity, not advertising incrementality or net profit

metrics.name: Complete-component order contribution subtotal
metrics.definition: Operational contribution only for fully priced sales lines and complete nonnegative shipping components
metrics.null_policy: Null if no order satisfies both coverage conditions
metrics.limits: A selected-population subtotal, not a lower bound or a whole-business margin estimate; advertising is not allocated to this subset

metrics.name: Delivered item GMV
metrics.definition: SUM(item price) on documented delivered positive-GMV purchase-window orders
metrics.null_policy: Orders without items are excluded and counted
metrics.limits: Independent public population; excludes freight and is not recognized net revenue

metrics.name: Observed monthly repeat-purchase retention
metrics.definition: Distinct active customer identities / original first-observed cohort size
metrics.denominator: Original cohort, constant across observed ages
metrics.null_policy: Observed inactivity is zero; future cells are null
metrics.limits: Retrospective delivered status and first-observed history; not lifetime acquisition or churn

metrics.name: Probability of another purchase day
metrics.definition: One minus Kaplan-Meier survival to a second distinct purchase day
metrics.denominator: Observed risk set accounting for administrative censoring
metrics.null_policy: No estimate after risk-set exhaustion; boundary confidence intervals are null
metrics.limits: Independent censoring is unverified; pointwise intervals are not simultaneous bands or churn forecasts

metrics.name: Comparable delivered-order late rate
metrics.definition: Actual delivery calendar date later than promised calendar date / eligible delivered orders
metrics.denominator: Valid-date positive-GMV delivered orders in matched seven-month windows
metrics.null_policy: Missing/invalid dates are excluded and counted; no review-response filter
metrics.limits: Delivered-only retrospective endpoint; standardization and rate/mix components are not causal effects
